name: foldspace
summary: Foldspace enables the scheduling and execution of web services on remote HPC compute nodes, exposing them via SSH tunnels to a local browser. Inspired by Open OnDemand (https://openondemand.org/), it replaces the Apache/Nginx stack with Python scripts and SSH tunnels, allowing any user to run it on any HPC cluster without root privileges. For more details on the client and backend, please check the --help option and visit the official website.
